description.narrative: 1. Improved transport and logistics capacities framework

comment.narrative: The Annual Report of the intervention covering period up to 31 December 2021 under Section 1.3 on page 12 states The blackspots prioritization activity resulted in the short list of blackspots recommended for improvement by the consultant which was confirmed by the Promoter. In Q1 2022 the Consultant will proceed with development of design basis for blackspots improvement works detailed design. As the first step when the weather conditions allow they will do geodetic surveys and then will proceed with further detailed design development. As of 31 December 2021 EUR 99000 have been disbursed under this contract.Thus based on the above information physical activities for blackspots improvement are yet to be carried out and as of yet no blackspot has been improved in actual.
